run_point_sup_training: run the point supervision training script with a config file and optional command line arguments
run_eval_only: run evaluation only mode to test a model on a dataset using saved checkpoint weights
build_evaluator_coco: build a COCO evaluator for a given dataset name and output folder for inference results
build_train_loader: build a detection training data loader with optional point supervision dataset mapper
setup_config: setup detectron2 config by merging point rend and point sup configs from a config file
